title: A script becomes a voiced animatic
pitch: Three beats of a story in. Three drawn panels, a narrator, and a timed animatic out.
why: An animatic is timing, not polish. Anima draws the panels in one style, Kokoro reads each beat, and each panel stays on screen exactly as long as its line.

fields.label: Beat 1
fields.default: On the roof of the tallest building, a small robot gardener wakes up with the sun.

fields.label: Beat 2
fields.default: It waters every pot in a long row, one careful drop at a time.

fields.label: Beat 3
fields.default: When the last flower opens, it sits down and watches the city wake.

models.name: Anima
models.note: Non-commercial: this whole result can't be sold while it contains Anima frames.

models.name: ffmpeg

tips: Anima is non-commercial. Swap the panels for your own drawings if you need to sell the animatic.

steps.label: Panel 1
steps.prompt: storyboard panel, loose ink lines with soft grey wash, cinematic framing, a small round robot gardener on a rooftop garden at sunrise, wide shot, city skyline behind

steps.label: Panel 2
steps.prompt: storyboard panel, loose ink lines with soft grey wash, cinematic framing, a small round robot gardener watering a long row of flower pots with a tiny watering can, medium shot

steps.label: Panel 3
steps.prompt: storyboard panel, loose ink lines with soft grey wash, cinematic framing, a small round robot gardener sitting at the roof edge beside open flowers, seen from behind, the city at sunrise

steps.label: Shot 1
steps.does: The panel held for its line, with a slow push in.
